strategy.title: Your Brain Edits Reality Before You Ever See It
strategy.hook: Every glance is compressed, corrected, and partly invented before it reaches conscious awareness.

story_structure.opening: Begin with the familiar visible result of visual perception before revealing what is hidden.
story_structure.escalation: Use a cutaway sequence to connect trigger, mechanism, and visible outcome.
story_structure.takeaway: Finish by reconnecting the hidden mechanism to an everyday observation.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Layered cutaway of visual perception; visible surface above, hidden mechanism below, luminous directional flow, three linked stages, precise focal hierarchy
